name: Pro Ticket Console
description: Three-pane support inbox: resizable, persisted queue / thread / details panes, a virtualised queue that handles 20k tickets, shift-range multi-select with bulk actions and undo, live business-hours SLA countdowns, j/k/e/# keyboard triage, agent collision indicators and macros.

props.name: currentUser
props.description: Signed-in agent; drives 'Mine', assign-to-me and collision filtering

props.name: onTicketsChange
props.description: Called with the next array after any edit, bulk action, macro or undo

props.name: onAction
props.description: Semantic action log for syncing to your API

props.name: loadThread
props.description: Loads a conversation; cached per ticket with TanStack Query

props.name: onReply
props.description: Send handler; reject to roll back the optimistic message

props.name: macros
props.description: Macros: a patch (status, priority, assignee, tags) plus optional canned reply with {{name}}

props.name: businessHours
props.description: Team zone, working days, start/end and holidays for SLA maths

props.name: slaPolicy
props.description: Business minutes to next response per priority

props.name: view / defaultView / onViewChange
props.description: open | mine | unassigned | breaching | solved | all

props.name: layoutId
props.description: Storage key for the persisted pane layout

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Share a QueryClient with the host app
